text: Il-Qorti ordnat li l-avviz jigi ppubblikat fir-Registru Pubbliku.

translation_metadata.target_text: The Court ordered that the notice be published in the Public Registry.

text: L-applikant ghandu jipprezenta r-risposta fi zmien ghoxrin jum.

translation_metadata.target_text: The applicant shall file the reply within twenty days.

text: The registrar shall notify the parties of the next sitting.

translation_metadata.target_text: Ir-registratur ghandu jinnotifika lill-partijiet bis-seduta li jmiss.

text: Il-mandat jibqa' fis-sehh sakemm il-Qorti tordna mod iehor.

translation_metadata.target_text: The warrant remains in force until the Court orders otherwise.

text: The decree was delivered in open court on the stated date.

translation_metadata.target_text: Id-digriet inghata f'qorti miftuha fid-data indikata.
